Apache Dubbo RPC framework — ~4050 Java files, Maven multi-module, not buildable without network deps.

Refactor #1: Extracted `AbstractLRUCache<K,V>` (package-private) as base class for `LRUCache` and `LRU2Cache` in `dubbo-common/src/main/java/org/apache/dubbo/common/utils/`. The two concrete caches duplicated: constants, lock/maxCapacity fields, five locked overrides (containsKey/get/size/clear/removeEldestEntry), getMaxCapacity/setMaxCapacity, trimToSize. Base class uses `onClear()` and `onSetMaxCapacity(int)` hooks so `LRU2Cache` can also update its `preCache` state. Net: −160 lines. `LRUCache.lock()`/`releaseLock()` still public — used externally by `AbstractCacheManager`.

Refactor #2: Extracted `AbstractConditionRouter<T>` (package-private) as base class for `ConditionStateRouter` and `MultiDestConditionRouter` in `dubbo-cluster/.../router/condition/`. Duplicated: `logger`, `ROUTE_PATTERN`, `matcherFactories`, `whenCondition`, `enabled`, `parseRule()`, `getMatcher()`, `doMatch()`, `matchWhen()`. Also removed `MultiDestConditionRouter`'s redundant `force`/`isForce()`/`setForce()` that shadowed `AbstractStateRouter`'s (the parent field was never being set — latent bug). Net: ~−140 lines across the two concrete classes.

Refactor #3: Extracted `AbstractProviderAppStateRouter<T>` (public) as base class for `ProviderAppStateRouter` and `AffinityProviderAppStateRouter` in `dubbo-cluster/.../router/condition/config/`. The two files were byte-for-byte identical except class name, `NAME` constant, and one word in a warning message. Template Method pattern with `getRouterTypeName()` hook. Net: ~−100 lines.

Refactor #4: Extracted `AbstractHttpHeadersAdapter<H>` (package-private, generic) as base for `Http2HeadersAdapter` and `Http3HeadersAdapter` in `dubbo-remoting-http3/.../netty4/`. Both 626-line classes were mirror images differing only in Http2/Http3 type names. A generic base `AbstractHttpHeadersAdapter<H extends Headers<CharSequence,CharSequence,?>>` holds 63 non-fluent delegate methods from `Headers<K,V,T>`. Using a type parameter (not a raw field) preserves the concrete wrapped type in each subclass so protocol-specific methods (`method()`/`scheme()` etc.) work without casts. Net: ~−680 lines.

Refactor #5: Extracted `selectWithWeight()` as a `protected static` helper in `AbstractLoadBalance` in `dubbo-cluster/.../loadbalance/`. Both `LeastActiveLoadBalance` and `ShortestResponseLoadBalance` ended with a verbatim identical 14-line block: (a) return sole candidate, (b) weighted-random if unequal weights, (c) uniform-random fallback. Moved `ThreadLocalRandom` import to `AbstractLoadBalance`; removed it from the two concrete classes. Net: −4 lines (32 added, 36 removed).

**Why:** Extract Method into base class; identical selection tail in both metric-based load balancers.
**How to apply:** Compile via stub javac — copy the 3 files to a temp dir and `javac` them together (no external deps needed for these files). Http adapter files need Netty jars (not available without network).

Refactor #6: Pulled up `toMergeInvokerList(List<Invoker<T>>)` from `RegistryDirectory` and `ServiceDiscoveryRegistryDirectory` into their shared base `DynamicDirectory` in `dubbo-registry/dubbo-registry-api/.../integration/`. Both 22-line methods were byte-for-byte identical; the method only accesses `cluster` (a `protected final` field already in `DynamicDirectory`) and `StaticDirectory`. Added `StaticDirectory`, `ArrayList`, `HashMap`, `Map` imports to `DynamicDirectory`; removed the now-unused `StaticDirectory` import from each concrete class. Net: −21 lines across 3 files.

Refactor #7: Two Extract Method simplifications in separate files (−41 lines total, commit `5751095aa`):
- `FastJson2ObjectInput.java` (`dubbo-serialization-fastjson2`): `readObject(Class<T> cls, Type type)` body was byte-for-byte identical to `readObject(Class<T> cls)` — the `type` parameter was completely unused. Replaced 35-line duplicate body with single-line delegation `return readObject(cls);`. Matches the pattern already in `Hessian2ObjectInput`.
- `TripleHttp2Protocol.java` (`dubbo-rpc-triple`): Merged `createHttp2ClientConnection(TripleConfig)` and `createHttp2ServerConnection(TripleConfig)` into `createHttp2Connection(boolean server, TripleConfig)`, differing only in the `DefaultHttp2Connection(server)` boolean. Updated 3 call sites. Net: −7 lines.

Refactor #9: Extracted `ensureCurrentClassLoader()` private helper in `Hessian2ObjectInput.java` (`dubbo-serialization-hessian2`). The 4-line classloader-check block was repeated verbatim in `readObject()`, `readObject(Class<T>)`, and `readObject(Class<T>,Type)`. The helper consolidates the check; `readObject(Class,Type)` now just delegates to `readObject(Class)` (no extra check needed). Net: −7 lines.

Refactor #10: Added `static void cleanup(Object obj)` helper to `Cleanable` interface (`dubbo-serialization-api`). The pattern `if (x instanceof Cleanable) { ((Cleanable) x).cleanup(); }` appeared verbatim in 7 places: `ExchangeCodec` (×3, variable `out`), `TransportCodec` (×2, variables `objectOutput`/`objectInput`), `DecodeableRpcInvocation` (variable `in`), `DecodeableRpcResult` (variable `in`). All 7 call sites now use `Cleanable.cleanup(x)`. Net: −7 lines across 5 files.

Fix #11: Fixed `DefaultSerializationExceptionWrapper.writeBytes(byte[], int, int)` in `dubbo-serialization-api`. The method was calling `target.writeBytes(v)` — silently dropping `off` and `len`, so the whole array was written instead of the intended slice. Changed to `target.writeBytes(v, off, len)`.

Refactor #13: Added `dispatchReceived(Channel, Object)` and `dispatchCaught(Channel, Throwable)` protected helpers to `WrappedChannelHandler` in `dubbo-remoting-api`. The executor-dispatch body for `received()` was byte-for-byte identical in `AllChannelHandler`, `MessageOnlyChannelHandler`, and `ConnectionOrderedChannelHandler`; `caught()` was identical in `All` and `Connection`. Three subclasses now call `dispatchReceived()`; two call `dispatchCaught()`. `ExecutionChannelHandler` and `DirectChannelHandler` have different `received()` logic and keep their own overrides. Net: −22 lines across 4 files.

Refactor #14: Moved the double-check-locked `destroy()` skeleton into `AbstractInvoker` (`dubbo-rpc-api`) with a `closeConnection()` hook. Both `DubboInvoker` and `TripleInvoker` duplicated: a `ReentrantLock destroyLock` field, a 20-line locked destroy frame (differing only in transport close: `clientsProvider.close(...)` vs `connectionClient.release()`), and the same two-line comment. The lock now lives in `AbstractInvoker`; subclasses override `closeConnection()` to remove from invoker set and close transport. Net: −15 lines across 3 files.

Refactor #15: Lifted `calculateLeastDuration` and `calculateReconnectDuration` into `UrlUtils` in `dubbo-remoting-api`. Both 6-line helpers were private in `AbstractClient`, `HeaderExchangeClient`, and `HeaderExchangeServer` (`calculateLeastDuration` in all three; `calculateReconnectDuration` in first two). `UrlUtils` already imported `remoting.Constants` and was already imported by all callers. Net: −32 lines across 4 files.

Refactor #16: Extracted `AbstractListenableStateRouter<T>` (in `router.state`) as base for `ListenableStateRouter` and `AffinityListenableStateRouter` in `dubbo-cluster`. Both duplicated: `ruleKey` field, constructor, `init()`, and `stop()` — differing only in `RULE_SUFFIX`. New abstract base holds the skeleton; subclasses override `getRuleSuffix()`. Also removed dead `isRuleRuntime()` private methods from both. Net: −25 lines across 2 files (new base adds 59, removes 85).

Refactor #17: Hoisted duplicated `customByteAccessor` construction in `DubboCodec.decodeBody()` (`dubbo-rpc-dubbo`). Both the response and request non-event decode paths contained an identical `if (customByteAccessor != null)` block inside both branches of the outer `isDecodeDataInIoThread` condition. Creation hoisted out; `.decode()` called conditionally afterward. Net: −25 lines in one file.

Refactor #18: Extracted `frameworkModel(URL)` helper in `FastJson2Serialization` and `factoryManager(URL)` helper in `Hessian2Serialization` (both in `dubbo-serialization`). FastJson2 duplicated the 4-line `Optional.ofNullable(url)...frameworkModel` chain four times; Hessian2 duplicated a 5-line manager lookup twice. Net: −10 lines across 2 files.

Refactor #19: Widened `setFutureWhenSync` from `private` to `protected` in `AbstractInvoker` (`dubbo-rpc-api`). `DubboInvoker`, `TripleInvoker`, and `InjvmInvoker` each redeclared the identical 2-line field. Subclasses drop their copies plus now-unused `SystemPropertyConfigUtils` imports (DubboInvoker also shed an unused `CommonConstants` import). Net: −12 lines across 4 files.

Refactor #19: Changed `AbstractInvoker.setFutureWhenSync` from `private` to `protected`; removed the byte-for-byte identical field declarations from `DubboInvoker`, `TripleInvoker`, and `InjvmInvoker` (all extend `AbstractInvoker`). Also removed now-unused `SystemPropertyConfigUtils` imports from all three subclasses, and the unused non-static `CommonConstants` import from `DubboInvoker`. Net: −12 lines across 4 files.

Refactor #15: Lifted `calculateLeastDuration(int)` and `calculateReconnectDuration(URL, long)` from three files into `UrlUtils` (`dubbo-remoting-api`). `calculateLeastDuration` was private in `AbstractClient`, `HeaderExchangeClient`, and `HeaderExchangeServer`; `calculateReconnectDuration` was private in the first two. All callers already imported from `UrlUtils`, which already imports `remoting.Constants`. Static imports replace the private calls. Net: −32 lines across 4 files.

Refactor #16: Extracted `AbstractListenableStateRouter<T>` (in `router.state`) as base for `ListenableStateRouter` and `AffinityListenableStateRouter` in `dubbo-cluster`. Both classes duplicated: `ruleKey` field, constructor, `init()` (10 lines, calls `getRuleSuffix()`), and `stop()`. Template Method with abstract `getRuleSuffix()` hook; subclasses return their `RULE_SUFFIX` constant. Also removed dead `isRuleRuntime()` private methods from both. Net: −25 lines across 2 files (new base 59 lines, removals 84 lines).

Refactor #12: Extracted `AbstractNettyChannelHandler extends ChannelDuplexHandler` (package-private) in `dubbo-remoting-netty4/netty4/`. Both `NettyClientHandler` and `NettyServerHandler` duplicated: `url`/`handler` fields, their null-guard constructor, a static logger, and the full `exceptionCaught` body (differing only in address-key order: client is local→remote, server is remote→local). Base class uses `protected abstract String firstAddressKey(NettyChannel)/secondAddressKey(NettyChannel)` hooks for the log format. Instance logger (`LoggerFactory.getErrorTypeAwareLogger(getClass())`) gives correct class name in each subclass. Net: −59 lines across 2 subclasses (new base 80 lines).

Refactor #8: Made `CopyOfFilterChainNode` extend `FilterChainNode` in `FilterChainBuilder.java` (`dubbo-cluster/.../filter/`). `CopyOfFilterChainNode` is an `@Experimental` replacement for `FilterChainNode` differing only in `invoke()` (adds AsyncRpcResult validation, no whenCompleteWithContext). All other members were byte-for-byte copies: 3 fields (originalInvoker, nextNode, filter), constructor body, and 6 methods (getOriginalInvoker, getInterface, getUrl, isAvailable, destroy, toString). With inheritance, only the LOGGER field, a `super()` constructor, and the `invoke()` override remain. `CopyOfClusterFilterChainNode` (which extends `CopyOfFilterChainNode`) is unaffected. Net: −33 lines.

Refactor #17: Hoisted duplicated `customByteAccessor != null` creation blocks in `DubboCodec.decodeBody()` (`dubbo-rpc-dubbo`). Both the response (non-event) and request (non-event) decode paths had an inner if/else for accessor vs. constructor selection that was byte-for-byte identical in both branches of the outer "decode in IO thread" condition. Pulled creation out before the condition; conditional `.decode()` call remains. Net: −25 lines.

Refactor #28 (same worktree as #20-#27): Extract Method (single-file) in `ListenerRegistryWrapper` (`dubbo-registry-api/.../registry/`). `register`/`unregister` had identical `try { if (registry != null) registry.X(url); } finally { if (!UrlUtils.isConsumer(url)) listenerEvent(sl -> sl.onX(url, registry)); }` differing only in registry call + listener callback. Extracted `registerAndNotify(URL, Runnable registryAction, Consumer<RegistryServiceListener> notification)`; register/unregister now one-line delegations with lambdas. register/unregister declare no checked exceptions so Runnable works; Consumer already imported. Did NOT touch subscribe/unsubscribe — asymmetric (subscribe null-guards registry, unsubscribe doesn't; neither has the !isConsumer guard) — left the latent inconsistency alone. Watch 120-col limit: wrapped both delegation calls to 2 lines (single-line register was 123 chars). Verified stub-javac (Registry/RegistryServiceListener/URL/CollectionUtils/UrlUtils/logger stubs). Net: −5 across 1 file.

Refactor #27 (same worktree as #20-#26, mirrors other-worktree #13): Pull Up Method into `WrappedChannelHandler` (`dubbo-remoting-api/.../transport/dispatcher/`). `received()` was byte-identical in `AllChannelHandler`, `MessageOnlyChannelHandler`, `ConnectionOrderedChannelHandler`; `caught()` identical in `All` + `ConnectionOrdered`. Added `protected dispatchReceived(Channel, Object)` + `protected dispatchCaught(Channel, Throwable)` to base (getPreferredExecutorService/getSharedExecutorService/sendFeedback/handler/logger all already in base; `getClass()` in error msgs stays dynamic → identical messages). Base gained imports `remoting.ExecutionException` + `java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException` (ChannelEventRunnable is same package). 3 subclasses now delegate; dropped their now-unused imports (Message* shed almost all). `DirectChannelHandler`/`ExecutionChannelHandler` have different received logic → untouched. Verified stub-javac (stub base carrying the 2 real helper bodies + leaf stubs; 3 subclasses compiled). Net: +39/−54 across 4 files.

Refactor #26 (same worktree as #20-#25): Extract Method (single-file) in `ProtocolSecurityWrapper` (`dubbo-rpc-api/.../protocol/`). `export` and `refer` duplicated the security-registration block inside their try/catch. Extracted two private helpers preserving EXACT statement order (no commutativity assumption): `refreshedConfigurator(URL)` = build `SerializeSecurityConfigurator` via `ScopeModelUtil.getModuleModel(url.getScopeModel()).getBeanFactory().getBean(...)` + refreshStatus/refreshCheck (identical, first in both); `registerServiceTypes(ssc, serviceModel)` = the two identical serviceModel `Optional.ofNullable(...).map(...).ifPresent(ssc::registerInterface)` blocks (same relative position in both). Each method keeps its own explicit-interface registration in place (export: `Optional.ofNullable(invoker.getInterface())` BEFORE; refer: `registerInterface(type)` direct, AFTER) so null-semantics/order untouched. Removed now-unused `ScopeModel` import (was only the inlined `scopeModel` local). Verified stub-javac (~16 dubbo stubs: URL/Protocol/Invoker/Exporter/ScopeModelUtil/ServiceModel/ServiceDescriptor/ServiceMetadata/SerializeSecurityConfigurator/logger/etc). Net: −25 across 1 file. REJECTED extracting a shared `Protocol` wrapper base (ProtocolListenerWrapper/SerializationWrapper/SecurityWrapper share field+ctor+getDefaultPort/destroy/getServers) — SPI ExtensionLoader wrapper-detection + @Activate + null-check-semantics divergence (SerializationWrapper lacks the null-check the others have) too risky without a runnable build.

Refactor #25 (same worktree as #20-#24): Extract Superclass `AbstractContainerTypeDefinitionBuilder implements DeclaredTypeDefinitionBuilder` in `dubbo-metadata-processor/.../annotation/processing/builder/`. `CollectionTypeDefinitionBuilder` and `MapTypeDefinitionBuilder` had byte-identical `build()` (new TypeDefinition(type.toString()); stream type-arguments → TypeDefinitionBuilder.build → filter nonNull → map getType → add to items) and near-identical `accept()` (elements.getTypeElement(X.getTypeName()).asType() → types.erasure → isAssignable) differing only Collection.class vs Map.class. Base holds both with `protected abstract Class<?> getTargetClass()` hook; subclasses now just return Collection.class/Map.class + keep their getPriority (MIN_PRIORITY-5 / -6). SPI file (META-INF/dubbo/internal/...TypeBuilder: collection-type/map-type) unchanged — subclasses stay concrete; abstract base not listed. GeneralTypeDefinitionBuilder.build differs (field properties) → left alone. Covered by Collection/MapTypeDefinitionBuilderTest. Verified stub-javac (stub Prioritized/TypeDefinition + package stubs TypeBuilder/DeclaredTypeDefinitionBuilder/TypeDefinitionBuilder; real javax.lang.model). Net: +76/−66 across 3 files (build logic 1 place not 2).

Refactor #24 (same worktree as #20-#23): Consolidate Conditional in `AbstractProxyFactory.getProxy(invoker, generic)` (`dubbo-rpc-api/.../proxy/`). The GenericService-variant registration was two mutually-exclusive `if` blocks that duplicated both the `interfaces.add(Dubbo2CompactUtils.getGenericServiceClass())` call and the `isEnabled() && isGenericServiceClassLoaded()` compact-check, and evaluated `GenericService.isAssignableFrom(invoker.getInterface())` twice. With g=isAssignableFrom and c=compact-check, the 4-case truth table reduces exactly to: `if (c) add compact; else if (!g) add GenericService`. All predicates side-effect-free so order/count irrelevant. Verified equivalence via standalone 4-case truth-table program (ALL MATCH). 12 lines → 6. Rejected deduping `AbstractFallbackJdkProxyFactory.getInvoker/getProxy` (near-identical fallback structure) — a shared helper needs a functional iface declaring `throws Throwable`, which Java precise-rethrow would force onto callers, breaking their `throws RpcException` signatures.

Refactor #23 (same worktree as #20/#21/#22): extracted `AbstractThreadPool implements ThreadPool` in `dubbo-common/.../threadpool/support/`. The 4 standard pools (`CachedThreadPool`, `FixedThreadPool`, `LimitedThreadPool`, `EagerThreadPool`) each `implements ThreadPool` directly and duplicated: the thread-name line `url.getParameter(THREAD_NAME_KEY, (String) url.getAttribute(THREAD_NAME_KEY, DEFAULT_THREAD_NAME))` (all 4) and the 7-line blocking-queue if/else (Cached+Limited identical; Fixed same + a warn log). Base adds `protected getThreadName(URL)` and `protected createBlockingQueue(int queues)`; all 4 now `extends AbstractThreadPool`. Fixed keeps its `queues<0` warn by logging it before calling `createBlockingQueue` (behavior identical). Eager uses only `getThreadName` (keeps its TaskQueue). Base lives in `support` (public abstract) so the `support.cached/.fixed/.limited/.eager` subpackages reach the protected helpers. Done. Here's the tenth refactoring.

## Refactoring #10: extract `collectClassLoaders` in `ConfigUtils`

**Where:** `dubbo-common/.../utils/ConfigUtils.java` (single file)

**The duplication:** the same three-line class-loader-list build appeared verbatim in `loadProperties(…, allowMultiFile, optional)` and `loadMigrationRule`:
```java
List<ClassLoader> classLoadersToLoad = new LinkedList<>();
classLoadersToLoad.add(ClassUtils.getClassLoader());
classLoadersToLoad.addAll(classLoaders);
```
Both then feed it into `ClassLoaderResourceLoader.loadResources(fileName, …)`.

**The change:** extracted `private static List<ClassLoader> collectClassLoaders(Set<ClassLoader>)` (default loader first, then the supplied ones), and inlined `collectClassLoaders(classLoaders)` directly into each `loadResources(...)` call.

This is a type-identical mechanical move — the helper returns the same `List<ClassLoader>` the call sites previously passed, and `List`/`LinkedList`/`ClassUtils` are already used elsewhere in the file, so there are no import changes.

**Net:** −6 lines; the ordering convention ("default class loader first, then the supplied ones") now lives in one place.

**Verification:** by inspection — the change is a purely mechanical, type-identical extraction. `ConfigUtils` has a large web of dependencies (`Configuration`, `InmemoryConfiguration`, `ClassLoaderResourceLoader`, `SystemPropertyConfigUtils`, `JsonUtils`, many constants), so a stub compile would be mostly stub-writing with little added assurance over reading the exact type flow. I also confirmed the longer `loadProperties` call site lands at exactly 120 columns — within Dubbo's limit.

This one is intentionally modest; I scanned `AbstractMetadataReport`'s store tasks and the rest of `ConfigUtils` first, but those were either already well-factored (delegating overloads) or diverged too much (the provider store path is wrapped in a `MetricsEventBus.post` the consumer path lacks) for a clean, behavior-preserving dedup.

That's ten independent, staged refactors now, still none committed. Want me to commit them?
